### What changed and how does it work?
This PR retry when encountered possible H2 disconnection messages.

issue_context.title: s3: should retry when HTTP/2 connection was cut down
issue_context.body:
## Enhancement
Ref: https://stackoverflow.com/questions/45209168/http2-server-sent-goaway-and-closed-the-connection-laststreamid-1999

For some S3-compatible storage, the connection may be cut down. It seems the SDK v1 doesn't support retry on reading HTTP body.

review_comments: nit, feels like it makes more sense to log after we exhausted the remaining retry.
Nit: Seems use it as the param of `contRetry` is better than an implied ref.
